summary_markdown:
The conversation concerns the technical details of a previous project involving ingesting raw third-party data from Japan. This process required setting up a ClickHouse instance in the Japanese region, reading hundreds of GBs of CSV files from S3, filtering the necessary data based on coordinates, and finally transferring it to the European ClickHouse instance.

This similar task is expected soon. [p3] indicated that the infrastructure for this process still exists, although currently stopped, suggesting reactivation should be straightforward. [me] confirmed that the necessary scripts are available and the work can proceed.
decisions: The previous data ingestion pipeline (Japan S3 -> ClickHouse) will be reused.
action_items: Review the existing Japanese infrastructure for potential reuse.
